title: Painting Work Safety Plan
description: Free Painting Work Safety Plan template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, before starting, housekeeping and waste.
html:

Hazards And Controls

HazardControl measure
Solvent vapours and fumesVentilation, low-VOC products, respirator with correct organic vapour filter
Fire and explosion from flammable paintsNo ignition sources, bonding, minimal quantities, flammables cabinet
Spray and overspraySpray booth or screens, respirator, protective coveralls
Working at heightPlatforms or scaffolds; ladders only for short tasks; harness where required
Lead or old paint disturbanceTest first; use controlled removal methods; do not dry sand
Skin and eye contactGloves, goggles, wash facilities
Confined space paintingPermit, gas testing, forced ventilation, standby person

Before Starting

☐ SDS available for every product and read by the team

☐ Painters trained and fit-tested for respirators

☐ Area barriered, signs displayed, adjacent workers informed

☐ Fire extinguishers placed at the work area

☐ Waste rags and containers stored in closed metal bins

☐ Spill kit and eyewash available

Housekeeping And Waste

1. Paint waste and empty containers are disposed of as hazardous waste through licensed

carriers.

2. Rags soaked in solvent or oil-based paint are kept in water-filled or closed metal

containers.
